# Knowledge

`client.knowledge` → `/api/v1/developer/knowledge` — Qdrant, chunk `chunkSize/chunkOverlap`, `topK` search.

```ts
const kb = await persona.knowledge.create({ name: 'Docs', providerId: 'prov_123', config:{} });
const up: UploadDocumentsResult = await persona.knowledge.uploadDocuments(kb._id, {}]); // up to 10 files, 20MB
const docs: KnowledgeDocument[] = await persona.knowledge.listDocuments(kb._id);
const hits: KnowledgeSearchResult[] = await persona.knowledge.search(kb._id, 'refund policy',{});
await persona.knowledge.deleteDocument(kb._id, 'handbook.pdf');
```

Related: [Agents mount knowledgeBases](/packages/sdk/v0.8.0/resources/agents)
